description: Explicit presentation whitelist for implemented source encounter rosters whose complete runtime membership and source commander flags have been verified. This data does not infer roles from node kind, name, portrait alias or first position.

sourceConfiguration.selection: The whitelisted Source2026 code uses the named main Ggroup. NewbieGroup is recorded by the source Fight table but is not selected automatically by this UI data.

sourceClient.behavior: The source preview filters hidden and later-chapter members, then partitions the surviving roster by the per-NPC IsBoss flag. Commanders are large cards and other members are lower portraits. If there is no commander, all surviving NPCs are large cards. It has no portrait-click main-card selection.
sourceClient.identity: For these groups Generalshow is zero, so the default figure_cool_master and figure_cool_winger identity images apply after successful matching. A different Generalshow value requires a separate verified mapping.

matchingContract.campaign: Require StandardShanheCampaignCatalog.IsSource2026Campaign(definition.Id, definition.SourceDifficultyId). The source difficulty must be in the explicit variant's inclusive interval.
matchingContract.source: Require a non-null whitelisted SourceBattleId and the frozen source member SHA256. sourceGroupId is the verified main group, not an inferred or automatically substituted newbie group.
matchingContract.roster: Require actual encounter.Enemies.Count and encounter.SourceVisibleEnemyCount to equal expectedVisibleEnemyCount. Compare every actual Enemies[index].GeneralId with the selected variant's full expectedRuntimeGeneralIds[index] using ordinal string equality.
matchingContract.members: Require one source member per actual runtime member, with the recorded rawOrdinal. This first batch admits only Hide=false, StartChapter<=current chapter, and Generalshow=0.
matchingContract.projection: Only after the entire roster matches, project each source IsBoss flag to its actual runtime seat, then partition the existing cards while preserving their relative runtime order and every actual enemy. Source members remain in raw source order. A verified non-positional roster records SourceOrdinalsInRuntimeOrder as a complete permutation paired with its full expected runtime ID sequence; an absent permutation uses raw ordinal order. Keep the complete roster and access to skill/rule descriptions available.
matchingContract.fallback: Unknown battle, missing identity data, wrong campaign, wrong difficulty, wrong count, IDs reordered or replaced relative to the audited runtime sequence, later-chapter/hidden rows, and unsupported Generalshow all retain the original full large-card preview. Do not use prefix matching, localized names, source-ID dictionaries that discard duplicates, or the first N source rows.
matchingContract.localProfiles: Local authored encounters, ordinary-to-elite replacement profiles and daily-travel extra encounters do not gain source roles merely because their artwork resembles a source NPC. Their absent SourceBattleId keeps the fallback behavior.
matchingContract.impact: Presentation metadata only. It adds no Core fields, save commands, global version or campaign content-fingerprint input.
